desc: 暖金花语淡香氛，剔透方瓶，清新百搭随手携带
leaf: 清新花香调女士淡香氛
name: 清新花语暖金淡香氛款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，白底合规突出瓶身
一秒传达清新花语核心利益，承接主图点击
放大长时间外出香气淡去无法补涂的尴尬，引出便携小瓶
代入约会与日常场合，让买家想象腕间一喷的瞬间
微距展示玻璃通透与琥珀色液体质感，证明品质
用金字塔信息图讲清前中后调结构，香调内容留白由文案填充
四步展示随手补涂的用法，强化小巧便携
用干净的参数行版式降低疑虑，具体数值后期填充
以礼赠氛围收口促单，营造送礼自用两相宜

style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for packshot, warm blush-beige #EFE3D8 and cream #F7F2EA panels for info and scene shots, one deep bronze #B08D57 accent panel for the closing shot
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons only in one bronze accent #B08D57
style.lightingSystem: soft warm studio light, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, controlled warm highlights on glass
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm floral fragrance visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cream off-white #F7F2EA, warm blush-beige #EFE3D8, bronze-gold accent #B08D57 and deep charcoal-brown text #3A3430; soft warm studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with generous letter spacing; consistent thin-line icon style; clean premium fragrance photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no added fragrance-note text beyond placeholders
style.presentationRules: stable upright bottle hero angle and scale across the set, product always clearly the subject
style.surfaceSystem: matte cream stone counter #E4D5C3 and smooth white display plinth
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif with generous letter spacing
